todo.title: Add visual indicators for active kitten trait effects
todo.description:
Critic review notes: traits have real mechanical impact but the UI only shows trait names with a percentage on hover. Add subtle per-kitten visual cues when a trait is actively boosting or penalizing output. A small colored dot or icon next to the kitten name (green for positive trait active, amber for negative). This makes the personality system feel alive and teaches players organically without a tutorial. Tier 2: visual feel.

[REJECTED 2026-03-14T11:52:50.465Z] Indicator can show amber mismatch without an active negative trait modifier; acceptance criterion requires active trait effect indication.
acceptanceCriteria: Each kitten displays a visible indicator when their trait is actively modifying output
Positive traits show a distinct visual (green dot or arrow-up) vs negative traits (amber dot or arrow-down)
Indicators update in real-time as trait effects apply during simulation ticks
No performance regression - indicators use CSS only, no heavy JS animation
todo.reworkNote: Indicator shows amber even without active negative modifier. Must only indicate when trait IS actively modifying output.

todo.title: Enhance resource fly-up animations for significant gains
todo.description:
Arbiter review notes the +X fly-up popups are small and fast. For significant gains (building complete, active event claimed, prestige bonuses), fly-ups should be larger, slower, and more satisfying. Reference: Cookie Clicker golden cookie popups scale with value. Keep it CSS-only - bigger font-size, slower translateY, maybe a brief scale-up pulse. This is Tier 2 (visual feel) work that directly targets the visuals axis (8.5).

[REJECTED 2026-03-14T13:22:51.611Z] Significant fly-ups are threshold-based only; building completion is not explicitly handled per acceptance criterion 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Significant gains (building completion, event claims) show larger fly-up text than routine +1 ticks
Fly-up animation duration is at least 1.5s for significant gains vs current speed
No new JS animation libraries - CSS transitions/keyframes only
Normal per-tick fly-ups remain unchanged
todo.reworkNote: Significant fly-ups are threshold-based only; building completion events must be explicitly detected and trigger the enhanced animation, not just high-value gains.

KKC should have a layered ambient system: base colony hum that thickens with population, seasonal audio shifts (rain, wind), faction-specific motifs, and intensity scaling during events. acceptanceCriteria: Design doc maps colony states to ambient sound layers (population tiers, seasons, factions)

todo.title: Implement session performance metrics and play-time statistics panel
todo.description: Completeness gap. Every polished incremental has a stats page — Cookie Clicker has detailed stats, Antimatter Dimensions tracks everything. KKC needs a Statistics tab showing: total play time, resources gathered lifetime, prestige count, kittens born/lost, faction events triggered, longest streak. This is Tier 1 engagement (completionist loop), not Tier 5 infrastructure. Use existing save data where possible. Dark-themed, scrollable list. NOTE: Has 4 criteria — consider splitting before claiming.
acceptanceCriteria: Statistics panel accessible from main UI with at least 8 tracked metrics
Lifetime totals persist across prestige resets

blocked.title: Add global error boundary with player-friendly recovery UI
blocked.description: Stability is at 6.5 and the 540KB monolith has no error handling for runtime failures. If any JS error occurs, the game silently breaks. Cookie Clicker wraps core loops in try-catch and shows a recovery prompt. KKC should catch unhandled errors, display a non-scary modal, and offer auto-reload. Prevents silent breakage and builds player trust.
acceptanceCriteria: window.onerror and unhandledrejection listeners catch all uncaught errors
Error modal displays with friendly message and reload button

Error details logged to console for debugging
No visible impact during normal gameplay
blocked.blockedReason: Tier 5 infrastructure — priority stack violation. Focus on gameplay tasks first.

blocked.title: Add defensive error wrapping around colony AI tick to prevent cascade failures
blocked.description: The 540KB monolith has no error isolation between subsystems. If colony AI throws during a tick, it can cascade and break the game loop. Wrapping the AI decision cycle, society feed updates, and seasonal transitions in try-catch with fallback behavior would significantly improve stability without requiring the full modular refactor (TASK-007). This is the incremental stability win: protect the core loop from subsystem failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Colony AI tick wrapped in try-catch - errors logged to console but game loop continues
Society feed update failures do not halt resource production
Seasonal transition errors fall back to default season without crashing

No user-visible impact from caught errors - game keeps running
blocked.blockedReason: Tier 5 infrastructure — priority stack violation. Focus on gameplay tasks first.
